subject: Original-client six-Thrax courtyard combat from a copied upper-path checkpoint

setup.client: Recovered 1.16.5.0 client under Wine/Xvfb in bubblewrap private network and process namespaces; current staged game binary; live service and databases untouched
setup.copied_character: Level-2 Alden, mission 1994 objective 2 active, placed at (316.13,120.28,85.93) before login; baseline 3571 XP and 310 credits
setup.copied_world: All six Thrax placements 198660-198665, three conditioned camp companions 198688-198690, and staged Warrior 198691 at (294,120.5,65) with behavior 2. The current six-Thrax health and armor are analogue values, and the Warrior class, health, position and attacks are labelled reconstructions.
setup.trace: RASA_TRACE_CREATURE_HITS=1 in the isolated game process. Bounded xdotool holds were used for movement and later rifle fire; no GM teleport or direct combat-state edits occurred after login. The initial character checkpoint itself bypassed the camp-to-checkpoint walk.

timeline.event: Client is still at the copied checkpoint (316.1,120.3,85.9). First Warrior and Thrax hit traces begin by 13:29:45, before the first player movement input at 13:30:12.
Thrax 198660 kills staged Warrior 198691 after 49 incoming traced hits. The Warrior landed 3 traced hits on 198660.

Bounded ordinary movement takes the player to approximately (312.7,119.8,78.7); a later short push leaves the player at (311.1,119.8,79.6). The rock/sandbag line prevents a further straight advance. This does not reproduce the uninterrupted filmed approach.
Shaman 198690 kills Thrax 198665. The Gunner, Archer and Shaman dealt 10, 11 and 11 hits respectively to that Thrax; the player did not fire and received no kill XP or credits at this point.
Thrax kill the Archer, Shaman and Gunner. Across the run those companions dealt 18, 20 and 25 outgoing traced hits against Thrax; the Warrior dealt 3. One Thrax had been killed by allies.
Alden's rifle hit for 106 kills Thrax 198661 from 2 to 0 HP. The client shows 71 XP and 10 credits. The next 106-damage hit consumes 100 armor and reduces Thrax 198662 from 555 to 549 HP.
Alden dies at (311.1,119.8,79.6), killed by Thrax 198662. Hospital Selection opens; rifle display is 0/1000 after the final input.

saved_state: Stopped copied character database: 3642 XP, 320 credits, mission 1994 objective 2 still active and objective 4 complete; no 1994 objective counter row. The increase is 71 XP and 10 credits from the one player killing blow. Original 3571/310 baseline was checked against the untouched checkpoint copy.
interpretation: The staged follow/leash fix permits all three companions to hit a Thrax with all six hostile placements present, and the copied client can award a player kill from this checkpoint. It does not establish retail ally damage, original simultaneous hostile count, spawn timing, Warrior lifespan, or a playable full encounter. The long pauses between inputs make elapsed fight time incomparable with the final-week video. All four seeded allies die and four Thrax remain when the player dies in this run.
verification_needed: A continuous camp-to-courtyard approach and a completed six-Thrax fight using only normal client movement, firing, reload and cover; then compare original video reward intervals and actor formation before retuning any estimated seed value.
